chunks.text:
[Intro]
{two bars of sampled marching snare and kick alone set the pace, then the lead strikes the climbing figure and the theme begins}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
high pulse-wave lead climbing in stepwise terraces
steady ascending arpeggio like footsteps on stone
sampled 16-bit marching snare and kick on a steady march beat
white-noise wind swell cresting every four bars
mountain climbing route theme, determined and airy, sunset thinning to cold blue
